POLICY
Description
iRules command namespace which allows inspection and modification of
centralized policy matching (CPM) policies.
CPM replaces the HTTP class profile and
HTTP_CLASS_SELECTED
HTTP_CLASS_FAILED
events in
v11.4
Command List
POLICY::controls
- iRule command which
returns details about the policy controls for the virtual server
the iRule is enabled on
POLICY::names
- iRule command which
returns details about the policy names for the virtual server the
iRule is enabled on.
POLICY::rules
- Returns the policy rules
of the supplied policy that had actions executed.
POLICY::targets
- Returns or sets
properties of the policy rule targets for the policies associated
with the virtual server that the iRule is enabled on
Event List
HTTP_REQUEST
HTTP_RESPONSE
Related Information
See the
HTTP_CLASS_SELECTED
HTTP_CLASS_FAILED
events which CPM replaces
in v11.4
